description: This file contains SQL schema definitions for an educational platform, including table creation, enum types, triggers, policies for row-level security, and indexes. It defines the database structure for users, courses, enrollments, modules, assignments, submissions, quizzes, questions, attempts, chat messages, and announcements, along with associated security policies.

methods.name: public.set_updated_at()
methods.description: A trigger function to automatically update the 'updated_at' timestamp on rows before update.

methods.name: public.handle_new_user()
methods.description: A trigger function that auto-provisions a profile for new auth users, assigning roles based on user metadata.

methods.name: public.current_user_role()
methods.description: A function that retrieves the role of the current authenticated user based on their profile.
